ftb.guhs_onderwol.title: &dUnder the Wool
ftb.guhs_onderwol.sub: Mining, caves and glitter under the Guhmension
ftb.guhs_onderwol.section.ow_dorpen: Mijnguh Village and Vads Mine Town
ftb.guhs_onderwol.section.ow_boven: Above the wool: a happier land
This chapter comes after &dWelcome to the Guhmension!&r in &dThe Guhmension&r: grab a pickaxe and dig down.

Under the pink wool lie layers of &dFelt Stone&r, &dSnugglestone&r and &dGuh Crystal Stone&r, with ores in every layer, caves with their own mood (and a happy little tune), sauce lakes, creatures and dozens of buildings. The &6Super Compass&r (tab &6Underground&r) shows the way to the buildings, and the cave minigames are under &6Minigames&r.

You only find all this in new parts of the world. Nothing is locked: every quest ticks itself off as soon as you have done it, even if you did it before. The headings show what logically comes after what. Tick this off and get vadsing!
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_viltsteen.title: Under the wool
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_viltsteen.desc: Dig down through the pink wool. A little below the surface the wool stops and the &dFelt Stone&r begins: soft, quick to mine and the first layer of the Guhmension underground. Mine 16!
Felt Stone is a lovely building block too: polished, as bricks, tiles or chiselled, with stairs, slabs and walls. Make them at the crafting table or the stonecutter. Start with Felt Stone Bricks.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_knuffelsteen.desc: Deeper down the stone gets harder: &dSnugglestone&r. It used to be expensive, now you simply mine it out of the ground. Under mountains it starts higher, under valleys and the sea lower.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_roze_knuffelsteen: Pink veins of &dPink Plush Stone&r run through the Snugglestone, with little pockets of pink wool here and there and rose quartz drops on the walls.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_kristalsteen.desc: Deeper still, where the caves get gigantic: &dGuh Crystal Stone&r. Below it there is only the &5Plush Seam&r: you can't get through that, njeg.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_guhklei.title: Guh Clay
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_guhklei.desc: The Felt Stone and the Snugglestone hold big blobs of &dGuh Clay&r. Mine them normally and you get clay balls (for bricks). With Silk Touch you keep the block whole, and that bakes into pink terracotta. The Miner in Vads Mine Town sells it too.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_viltkiezel.title: Felt Gravel
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_viltkiezel.desc: Along brooks and shores lies &dFelt Gravel&r: soft gravel made of little felt balls. It falls just like gravel.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_ijzer.title: Iron in the Felt Stone
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_ijzer.desc: Every layer has its own ores: coal, copper, iron, gold, lapis, redstone, diamond and emerald, just like in the Overworld, but in Felt Stone, Snugglestone or Crystal Stone. Iron is most common around the border of Felt Stone and Snugglestone.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_vads.title: Vads from the stone
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_vads.desc: Vads ore sits in the Snugglestone and the Crystal Stone, most of all deep down. Deeper is richer!
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_kaaskorrel.title: Cheese crumbs
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_kaaskorrel.desc: Around the sauce lakes there is cheese crumb ore. Mine it and you get cheese crumbs.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_pigment.title: Pastel from the stone
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_pigment.desc: Pigment ore in the Snugglestone gives pastel dye, and the rarer colours sit deeper. Just right for pastel bricks and plaster! Start with pink.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_diamant.title: Diamond in the Crystal Stone
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_diamant.desc: Diamond ore sits mostly deep in the Guh Crystal Stone. Bring a good pickaxe!
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_vahoegiet.title: VAHOEGITE!
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_vahoegiet.desc: The rarest ore: &5Vahoegite&r. Only in the Guh Crystal Stone, very deep, and in the plush heart geodes. You need it for the Glitter Altar, the Saddle Bag, super vahoege vads and the Miner Guh House.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_grot_pluisgrot.de: A soft cave in the Felt Stone: fluff wool, fluff grass, fluff balls and fluff cushions you land on softly (with a little bounce).
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_grot_slaapgrot.de: A cave full of fluff cushions and wool, with night lights. Wild guhs lie there sleeping: zzz... Pet one and it wakes up.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_grot_knuffelworte: Only under forests: hanging plush tree roots, moss and soft plush root soil.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_grot_glitterspelo: Pink glow moss, glitter vines with glitter berries, glitter toadstools and wild glowworms. It sparkles in every direction!
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_grot_belletjesgro: Crystals that play a note when you step on them or tap them. Every spot has its own note: play a tune!
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_grot_kristalpegel: Pink guh crystal icicles on the ceiling and the floor, with drops of cheese sauce. Mind your head: a falling icicle hurts!
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_glitterbes.title: Glitter berries
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_glitterbes.desc: Pick a glitter berry from a glitter vine in the Glitter Cavern (right-click). Deliciously sparkly!
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_belletjes.title: Ding dong guh
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_belletjes.desc: Take a Bell Crystal home from the Little Bells Cave and build your own guh xylophone.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_grotguh.title: The Cave Guh
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_grotguh.desc: The caves are mostly home to ordinary wild guhs, but very rarely you see a &dCave Guh&r: deep pink, with crystal speckles that glow softly in the dark. A little more often in the Glitter Cavern. Come close for your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_molguh.title: Peekaboo!
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_molguh.desc: In the Felt Stone and Snugglestone caves a &dmole guh&r with little glasses sometimes pops its head out of the ground. Now and then it leaves something behind: guh clay, dye or (very rarely) Vahoegite. Come close for your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_bouw_verlaten_guh: An old tunnel network of the miner guhs, just like a mineshaft: chest sleds, a canteen, a sled depot and a collapsed bit here and there. Look in the sleds! (Super Compass: Underground.)
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_bouw_grotschilder: A tall hall with a big fresco all around: how everything turned pink, and the Plush Heart. Read the signs at every scene. (Super Compass: Underground.)
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_bouw_sausmeer_vis: A hut on stilts by a warm cheese sauce lake. The fish don't bite, the cheese does. (Super Compass: Underground.)
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_bouw_verlaten_sle: Platforms, sleds and a ticket office, deep under the ground. Departure: never. (Super Compass: Underground.)
Sauce pumps, cheese vats and giant cheese wheels by a warm sauce lake. Don't dive into the vat! (Super Compass: Underground.)
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_bouw_verzonken_gu: House Fluff once sank through the wool. Crooked, mossy, and somebody still lives there. (Super Compass: Underground.)
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_bouw_reuzenguh_fo: The skeleton of a primeval guh, deep in the Crystal Stone. Yes, the ears really were that big. (Super Compass: Underground.)
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_bouw_kristalkweke: Growing beds full of guh crystals in four stages. Don't touch, they're still growing! (Super Compass: Underground.)
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_bouw_verdwaalde_b: An abandoned building site: half a tunnel, a little crane and piles of building materials. Where did the builder guhs go? (Super Compass: Underground.)
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_bouw_grotguh_hole: The cosy home of the Cave Guhs: sleeping nooks, a campfire and a nibble store. (Super Compass: Underground.)
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_bouw_badhuis.desc: A Roman bathhouse under the wool: three bath halls, nibble baths and cheese shakes. No running, only vadsing! The chests sometimes hold a &dBathrobe&r and a &dTowel Turban&r. (Super Compass: Underground.)
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_bouw_grotdisco.de: A secret disco in a crystal geode. DJ Njeg spins, the guhs dance up chonk power together. (Super Compass: Underground.)
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_bouw_oude_wolspin: The Wool Club: guhs spin wool together around tea tables, and a water wheel gives chonk power. Break time is every five minutes. (Super Compass: Underground.)
A quiet dome cave with a starry ceiling, a picnic and a star pond. Make a wish on a falling star (cheese nibbles, preferably). (Super Compass: Underground.)
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_bouw_knuffelslaap: An underground dormitory full of four-poster beds and sleeping guhs. Shhh! The chests sometimes hold a &dNightcap&r. (Super Compass: Underground.)
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_bouw_paddenstoele: Giant mushrooms with a little house in the cap: go through the door in the stem and climb up. With lights on strings and a glittering brook. (Super Compass: Underground.)
A ball pit full of plush blocks. Six little guhs are playing hide-and-seek: find them all! Shoes off. (Super Compass: Underground.)
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_bouw_verrassingsf: A hidden cave where guhs are getting a birthday party ready, with a giant cake. Shhh, don't tell! The chests sometimes hold a &dParty Hat&r and a &dBunting Scarf&r. (Super Compass: Underground.)
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_bouw_oude_guhtemp: Very rare: the huge temple complex of the old guhs, half buried, with The Great Guh and the Golden Cheese Nibble. Watch out for the sweet little traps, and find the path of light to the secret room. (Super Compass: Underground.)
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_bouw_oude_bankklu: Very rare: the old vault of the Bank Guh. Somebody tried to break in. Somebody with a moustache... (Super Compass: Underground.)
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_sjabloon.title: A super template
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_sjabloon.desc: The chests of the Old Guh Temple and the Old Bank Vault sometimes hold a &5Super Vads Template&r. Take good care of it! You can copy it: 7 Vahoegite and a Guh Crystal Stone.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_mijningang.title: The Mine Entrance Hut
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_mijningang.desc: Above the ground there is sometimes a hut with a &dCloud Lift&r: jump on it and you float down. Your mine starts here! (Super Compass: Underground.)
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_mijnguhdorp.title: Mijnguh Village
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_mijnguhdorp.desc: Under the ground lies the village of the &dMiner Guh&r (there is always one not too far from the middle of the world), around a warm sauce lake, with a cloud lift up. He has a little job for you: see &6Miner Guh's Helper&r at the cheese mine. (Super Compass: Underground.)
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_rugzakzadel.title: A bag full of ground
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_rugzakzadel.desc: Make a &6Saddle Bag&r (a saddle, a chest, pink wool and a Vahoegite) and put it on your tamed guh. It walks along with you and picks up every plain ground block you mine: wool, the layer stones, dirt, sand... Its bag holds endlessly much. Take things out in its little screen, or send everything to your Bank Guh.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_stadje.title: Vads Mine Town
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_stadje.desc: In a big cave hall lies a whole little town full of guh villagers, with a Guh Wheel power station on the square that gives the village chonk power. Four new professions live there: the Wizard Guh, the Vads Mechanic, the Miner and the Crystal Cutter. And the Iron Guhlem keeps watch, just like an iron golem. (Super Compass: Underground.)
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_villager.title: Pick it up
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_villager.desc: Sneak and click a villager with an empty hand (a guh villager or a normal one): you pick it up, with its name, profession and trades. Click a block to put it down again. Handy when moving house!
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_werkplek.title: A new profession
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_werkplek.desc: Make the workstation of one of the new professions: the Wizard Guh Book Stand, the Guh Wheel Workbench, the Ore Chest or the Crystal Grindstone. Put it near a villager without a job and it takes that profession. Start with the Vads Mechanic's Guh Wheel Workbench.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_altaar.title: The Glitter Altar
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_altaar.desc: The guh enchanting altar: a book, two Vahoegite, a guh crystal and three Guh Crystal Stone. Just like an enchanting table it costs lapis and levels. You get the useful vanilla enchantments, and guh spells you can only get here: &dMika Whacker&r, &dFluff Fall&r, &dGlitter Sight&r, &dVads Diligence&r and &dBaking Vads&r. The Wizard Guh sells spell books with even more: &dPiggy Guh&r, &dGentle Pat&r and &dCheese Nibble Scent&r.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_boekenkast.title: Cuddle Bookshelves
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_boekenkast.desc: The Glitter Altar gets stronger with &dCuddle Bookshelves&r around it (normal bookshelves don't count). You see hearts flying from the shelves to the altar. Make a few from guh blossom planks, pink wool and books.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_vadsknakker.title: The Vahoege Vadscracker
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_vadsknakker.desc: Put a vahoege vads paxel, vahoege vads shears and a vahoege vads hoe together at the crafting table: pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and shears in one! Their enchantments come along. Right-click is smart: grass becomes farmland, logs get stripped, a sheep gets sheared. Sneak and right-click grass: a path.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_vahoegietstaaf.de: Four Vahoegite and four vahoege vads ingots make a &5Vahoegite Ingot&r.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_super_vads.title: Super vahoege vads
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_super_vads.desc: At the smithing table: the Super Vads Template, a piece of vahoege vads and a Vahoegite Ingot. That makes your vads things super, as strong as netherite. Start with a Super Vahoege Vads Pickaxe.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_wolkenliftje.desc: Put a Cloud Lift at the bottom of your mine and one above it on the surface. Jump on it and you float up to the next one; sneak and you go down.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_pluisladder.title: The Fluff Ladder
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_pluisladder.desc: Put a Fluff Ladder against the wall at the edge of a hole: it unrolls down to the floor by itself.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_mijnlampje.title: A lamp for your guh
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_mijnlampje.desc: A pink helmet with a little lamp (a lantern and pink wool). Put it on your guh: it gives light in the dark wherever it walks. A walking lamp!
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_terrarium.title: A bigger terrarium
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_terrarium.desc: Terrariums can be as big as you like now: everything joined together by Terrarium Glass and Terrarium Floor is one living space, with little tunnels too and in any shape. Make Terrarium Floor from Terrarium Glass, sand and stripped oak.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_bloemenvallei.des: A small, rare valley full of flowers in every guh colour, with bees, butterflies and fluff in the air.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_bronnetje.title: From spring to spring
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_bronnetje.desc: The Guhmension has brooks now: they wind from one little spring to the next, with pink sparkles above the water and glitter reed along the banks. Take a Little Spring home for your own pond.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_roze_zand.title: A pink beach
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_roze_zand.desc: Next to the normal beaches there are pink beaches now, with little shells. Scoop up some pink sand.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.ow_hartjeslelie.desc: You only see it from above: some little lakes are shaped like a heart, with a rim of flowers. Pick a Heart Lily Pad.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.schatgraven_hal.desc: Above the ground stands a hut with a Cloud Lift down. In the cave below, &6Captain Shovelsnout&r waits with &6Sniffy&r (Super Compass: Minigames).
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.schatgraven_gespeeld: Dig up treasures with the soft shovel. Sniffy squeaks cold, warm or HOT and jumps when you're nearly there. A golden cheese is a bonus, a squeaky cheese costs time. You earn &6treasure coins&r.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.schatgraven_pakje.de: Buy the Pirate Hat and the Eye Patch from Captain Shovelsnout, for treasure coins.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.glimwormvangen_hal.d: Under a hut with a Cloud Lift lies a dark hall full of glowworms. That's where &6Miss Glimmy&r lives (Super Compass: Minigames).
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.glimwormvangen_gespe: Catch as many glowworms as you can. The jar on your back starts to glow and the hall gets lighter and lighter. A golden glowworm counts extra! You earn &6glimmer coins&r.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.glimwormvangen_pakje: Buy the Glowworm Feelers and the Butterfly Net from Miss Glimmy, for glimmer coins.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.lichtjespuzzel_hal.d: Under a hut with a Cloud Lift lies a cave with a big grid of toadstool lamps. &6Master Blinky&r explains it (Super Compass: Minigames).
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.lichtjespuzzel_gespe: A lamp flips, together with its four neighbours. Get them all on before the time runs out. A new puzzle every game! You earn &6lamp coins&r.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.lichtjespuzzel_pakje: Buy the Glowing Toadstool Hat from Master Blinky, for lamp coins.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.karretjes_grot.title: The Switch Cave
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.karretjes_grot.desc: Under a hut with a Cloud Lift lies a cave full of mine tracks. &6Conducteur Piepwiel&r is looking for a switch keeper (Super Compass: Minigames).
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.karretjes_gespeeld.d: Stand on the balcony and set the switches with the levers, so every ore cart rolls into the bin of its own colour. Lose three carts and the shift is over. You earn &6ore tickets&r.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.karretjes_25.title: On time, on track
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.karretjes_25.desc: Bring in 25 carts correctly in one shift.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.karretjes_lastig.des: Bring in 40 carts correctly on the hard network.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.karretjes_pakje.desc: Buy the Conductor's Cap from Conducteur Piepwiel, for ore tickets.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.kegelgrot_grot.title: The Bowling Cave
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.kegelgrot_grot.desc: Under a hut with a big pin on its roof lies a bowling alley in the cave. &6De Guhde&r lends you a wool ball (Super Compass: Minigames).
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.kegelgrot_gespeeld.d: Play a whole game: look where the ball should go, hold right-click for power and let go. Stand a little to the side for some hook. You earn &6pin buttons&r.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.kegelgrot_strike.des: Knock over all ten plush guh pins at once. Squeak squeak squeak!
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.kegelgrot_150.title: One hundred and fifty
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.kegelgrot_150.desc: Bowl 150 points or more in one game.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.kegelgrot_perfect.de: 300 points: twelve strikes in a row. The Guhde abides.
ftb.guhs_onderwol.q.kegelgrot_pakje.desc: Buy the Bowling Shirt and the Bowling Sweatband from De Guhde, for pin buttons.
New golf courses have 18 holes: a tour of the whole Guhmension, from the Cheese Swamp to the Great Guh Mouth. First play the front 9 once at or under par, then the new holes open. They're a lot harder: windmills, ramps, bumpers and slippery floors!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.golf18_18.title: Round the Guhmension
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.golf18_18.desc: Play all 18 holes in one round.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.golf18_trofee.title: The Golf Trophy
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.golf18_trofee.desc: Play all 18 holes at or under par. The Golf Guh gives you the &6Golf Trophy&r once, with your name and your record on it. Not for sale!
In the Golf Guh's shop: Checkered Felt (pink, mint or yellow, with stairs and slabs), 4 blocks for a little golf ball.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.golf18_karretje.tit: A golf cart of your own
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.golf18_karretje.des: The priciest thing in the golf shop: a golf cart to sit in, for 64 little golf balls. It doesn't drive, but it sure is comfy.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.voetjes_slofjes.title: Warm feet
ftb.guhs_basis.q.voetjes_slofjes.desc: The wardrobe has a new slot: &dfeet&r! Buy Fluffy Slippers from the tailor and put them on your guh.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.voetjes_regenlaarsjes.d: Yellow rain boots from the tailor: just right with the raincoat and the rain hat.
The Golf Guh sells Golf Shoes, for little golf balls.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.voetjes_mijnwerkerslaar: Miner's Boots are not for sale: they are very rarely in the chests of the Old Cheese Mineshaft (in the Holey Cheese Caves).
Cheese Sauce Striders are very rarely in the chests of the Mika Grill Palace and the Skewer Keep in the Guhbarbecuether. A tamed guh wearing them walks on top of every cheese sauce as if it were floor, and simply follows you to the other side.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.voetjes_lavalopers.desc: Bring the tailor Cheese Sauce Striders, 4 magma cream and a Wahoog Chonk (click him with the magma cream): he turns them into &6Lava Striders&r. With those your guh walks over real lava too.
